about.heading: About the game
about.homage: Masche & Co. is a homage to the co-op game “Scam With Your Friends” by JakeHub & Metater. All characters, names, graphics, texts and sounds are original versions.
about.fiction: All callers, companies, places and schemes are entirely made up. Nobody is actually called.
about.realWorld: Real-world tip: real banks and authorities never ask for passwords, codes or gift cards on the phone. When in doubt, hang up and call back yourself.
about.madeWith: Graphics, music and sounds are generated by code.

orientation.hint: Turn your phone sideways – then the whole office fits on screen.
